finals_source: winner only from the graded lock receipts data/snapshots/*_games_open.json (121 games); scores from data/review.json FINAL rows (122 games); scores from ESPN live, STATUS-gated FINAL (106 games)
rule: only LOCKED cards are graded; a prop leg hits when the market's yards reach the recorded line and a game leg is graded against FINAL scores (moneyline on the winner, spread on the margin against the handicap its selection states, an exact push void); a card is a hit only when every leg hit, a miss when any leg missed, void when something voided and nothing missed, and pending while any leg is unresolved -- an unresolved leg is never a miss; a leg of an owner-excluded game is void and a card made only of such legs is dropped (R108); calibration original_contract_v1 scores only complete hit/miss contracts, with its denominator and exclusions separate from settlement counts and money
